            0xF4: 0x00,  # ctrl_meas
            0xF5: 0x00,  # config
            0xF7: 0x00,  # press_msb
            0xF8: 0x00,  # press_lsb
            0xF9: 0x00,  # press_xlsb
            0xFA: 0x00,  # temp_msb
            0xFB: 0x00,  # temp_lsb
            0xFC: 0x00,  # temp_xlsb
            0xFD: 0x00,  # hum_msb
            0xFE: 0x00,  # hum_lsb
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            return 0xFFFF  # Invalid address
        value = self.regs[addr]
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF
        return value

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr == 0xE0:
            if data == 0xB6:
                self.__init__()  # Soft reset
            return
        if addr not in self.regs or self.regs[addr] & 0xFF80 != 0:  # RO registers
            return
        if nbytes == 1:
            data <<= 8
            data |= self.regs[addr] & 0xFF
        self.regs[addr] = data
